source='''def transform(grid):
    # Full separator rows/columns divide the board into small panels.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = grid[0][0]
    row_blocks = []
    start = 0
    for r in range(h):
        if all(v == sep for v in grid[r]):
            if start < r:
                row_blocks.append((start, r))
            start = r + 1
    if start < h:
        row_blocks.append((start, h))
    col_blocks = []
    start = 0
    for c in range(w):
        if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h)):
            if start < c:
                col_blocks.append((start, c))
            start = c + 1
    if start < w:
        col_blocks.append((start, w))
    # The unusual panel contains a pair of marker cells touching horizontally.
    marker = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v != sep and
                  any(x == v for x in row))
    # In these panels, the marker is the non-background color that is not a separator.
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != sep}
    background = max(colors, key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    marker = next(x for x in colors if x != background)
    out = [[background for _ in col_blocks] for _ in row_blocks]
    for i, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_blocks):
        for j, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_blocks):
            if any(grid[r][c] == marker and grid[r][c+1] == marker
                   for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1-1)):
                out[i][j] = 1
    return out
'''
